summary: PageExtractor can now read longer YouTube transcripts, waits for page checks to settle, and distinguishes pages redirected off-site from ordinary load timeouts. Redirects within the requested site are followed, with the site matched by its registrable domain. New profiler markers and Glean phase telemetry make its progress and outcomes easier to understand and measure; telemetry also bypasses Oblivious HTTP (OHTTP) and includes automatic client metadata.
